For each kernel W of dimension m-t, B has P_q(n,t) injection realizations; counting W intersects rad A in e and projects to a symplectic subspace of rank 2j gives displayed Gaussian-binomial sum S_q. Rank classification by congruence is valid including characteristic 2. Base K_{a,b} counts arbitrary rectangular rank-r matrices; odd-q character degrees follow orbit method.
